protocolName: Six-card referent, juxtaposition, and visual-result protocol
rationale: The transcript contains six deictic ‘这个’ claims whose referents exist only in short-lived tool cards. Each pairing is followed by a different edited result, and several meanings depend on motion or before/after state. The protocol therefore captures each name card at exact times, then densely samples the adjacent result sequence, while treating absent UI, prompts, parameters, and causality as explicit unknowns.

stoppingRules: Stop only when all six visible tool cards are captured at legible times and mapped to the correct cue and result interval.
Stop only when every critical question is answered or explicitly preserved as unknown.
Stop only when all six meaning-changing segments have evidence for card, claim, and result.
For character change, splash, co-frame appearance, outfit transitions, and illustration motion, stop only after before/during/after or sequence evidence has been captured.
Stop only when no supplied carrier remains unchecked, including the AI生成 label and editing juxtaposition.
Stop only when absent workflow UI, prompts, parameters, causality, identity, price, version, success rate, and usage conditions remain explicit unknowns rather than inferred facts.
Stop only when the missing DENSE-0024 ending interval has been resampled directly from the video.
Stop only when the meta-gate finds no unchecked carrier, meaning change, or relationship.
declaredUnknowns: No tool UI, prompt, input asset provenance, parameter, generation run, model/version, or export action is shown.
The montage does not establish that any named tool causally produced its adjacent result.
The older composited man's identity is not established.
Price, access requirements, availability, success rate, output consistency, and usage conditions are not established.
Small tool-card sublines and most PPT thumbnail copy may remain illegible even after high-resolution capture.
The evidence pack's DENSE-0024 frame file is missing; only direct video resampling can cover that instant.
